title: Training Notes: How a Battery Replacement Warranty Ends Without a Claim
content:
**The rule.** A Battery Replacement Warranty ends without a claim in two ways. The warranty must be in status active when it ends. It expires on the day after the last covered month, the line's prorated-through months after the purchase date. It is removed when Crestline records that the battery has left the purchaser's vehicle for any other reason, including the sale of the vehicle, since no line's warranty is transferable. A core deposit still held at the end is settled under the core deposit rules.

### Questions and answers

**Q. In what ways does a warranty end without a claim?**
A. Two: it expires, or it is removed.

**Q. When does a warranty expire?**
A. On the day after its last covered month, which falls the line's prorated-through months after the purchase date on the original ticket. For a line with no proration, the prorated-through figure equals the free period, so the last covered month is the last month of the free period. Expiry is booked by the system, with the closing date being the day after the last covered month ends.

**Q. When is a warranty removed?**
A. When Crestline records that the battery has left the purchaser's vehicle for a reason other than a warranty claim, such as the vehicle being sold or the battery being taken out. The closing date is the date recorded.

**Q. Does the sale of the vehicle pass the warranty to the buyer?**
A. No. The warranty is not transferable, so the battery leaving the purchaser's vehicle through the sale of the vehicle is a removal.

**Q. Can a warranty that is no longer active expire or be removed?**
A. No. The warranty must be in status active when it ends, so a warranty already adjusted, returned, expired or removed does not end again.

**Q. What happens to a core deposit still held when the warranty ends?**
A. It is settled under the core deposit rules; the ending of the warranty does not itself refund or forfeit it.

| Way of ending | Status required at the time | Closing date |
|---|---|---|
| Expiry | active | the day after the last covered month ends |
| Removal | active | the date recorded |
